messages.author: ded2bfb4448103c7
messages.subject: package ‘APE’ not found  error while trying to plot
parts:
I came back to some analysis but I am trying to redo them on a different machine. I already plotted the results before, but on this new machine with new trees I got this error while trying to plot it. library(ape) is of course loaded.

> res2 = plot_BioGeoBEARS_results(results_object, analysis_titletxt, 
+                                 addl_params=list("j"), plotwhat="pie", label.offset=1, 
+                                 tipcex=0.6, statecex=0.04, splitcex=0.04, titlecex=0.1, 
+                                 plotsplits=TRUE, cornercoords_loc=scriptdir, include_null_range=TRUE, 
+                                 tr=tr, tipranges=tipranges) # tamano perfecto, no text
 Show Traceback
 
 Rerun with Debug
 Error in packageVersion("APE") : package ‘APE’ not found 

Thanks for your help

parts:
Hi -- APE was recently updated to 5.0, and this caused some problems.

I recently added a version check for APE, since APE 5.0 plots differently.
Maybe some systems care about "APE" versus "ape", I'll see if I can provide
a fix.

I'm changing:

packageVersion("APE")
...to...
packageVersion("ape")

...in the plotting code. I've updated the plotting file, please re-run the source command:

(Or just re-start your script)

Let me know if there are issues...thanks for the bug report!

Cheers!
Nick
